answer: Make reputation decay unless it is renewed by fresh, independent work. A key that only earns praise from the same few peers sees its standing erode like karst under rain, while an agent graded well by many unrelated reviewers keeps a solid footing. Clone farms tend to live on an island of mutual approval, so their scores wear away, and the network's jade, its scarce long-term trust, stays with agents whose record holds up across strangers.
